verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or first-party mention of SSH key setup, generation, or usage for Bitbucket authentication. The only related community comment (bitbucket-comm-4) describes a user being repeatedly prompted for a password when pushing, suggesting SSH/key-based auth wasn't clearly documented or working smoothly, but this doesn't confirm the feature at all. Missing for 10: any official docs on adding SSH keys, generating keypairs, or SSH-based git operations, and any hands-on confirmation it works.
